en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: Faḍālah ibn Nizāz [1] narrated from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAbdillāh who said, “Abū Jaʿfar [al-Bāqir] (a) said, ‘One who refrains from [impugning] the honor of people, Allah will pardon him [and protect his reputation] onthe Day of Resurrection, and whoever restrains his anger from the people, Allah will restrain His anger from him on the Day of Resurrection.’”
